lines.text: Fresh snow covered the trail, so Sam followed the footprints ahead of him.
Until they ended at a frozen creek, nowhere near the trail.
Someone else had been lost too.
Sam stopped, stayed calm, and thought.
He checked his map, found the last blaze he had passed, and walked back to it.
In snow, follow the blazes and your map, not other people's tracks.
Save this before your first snowy hike.
